title: ArXiv: S3Gym: Can LLMs Turn Self-Testing and Self-Judging into Self-Improvement?
description: Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly interact with external environments and accumulate substantial behavioral experience, yet existing agent benchmarks largely evaluate them as fixed policies. I...

ko.title: S3Gym: LLM은 자체 테스트와 자체 평가를 통해 스스로 발전할 수 있는가?
ko.hook: 고정된 정책을 넘어 외부 환경에서 스스로 테스트하고 판단하며 진화하는 LLM 에이전트 환경을 만나보세요.
key_takeaways: LLM의 외부 환경 상호작용 및 행동 경험 누적 메커니즘 분석
자체 테스트(Self-Testing)와 자체 평가(Self-Judging)를 통한 자기 개선(Self-Improvement)
고정된 에이전트 벤치마크의 한계를 극복하는 동적 평가 환경 제공

en.title: S3Gym: Can LLMs Turn Self-Testing and Self-Judging into Self-Improvement?
en.hook: Discover how LLM agents can evolve beyond fixed policies through self-testing and self-judging in dynamic environments.
key_takeaways: Analyzes how LLMs interact with external environments and accumulate behavioral experience
Enables self-improvement via self-testing and self-judging mechanisms
Goes beyond fixed agent benchmarks to evaluate dynamic evolution capabilities

zh.title: S3Gym：LLM 能否将自我测试和自我评估转化为自我改进？
zh.hook: 探索大语言模型代理如何通过动态环境中的自我测试和自我评估超越固定策略进行进化。
key_takeaways: 分析 LLM 如何与外部环境交互并积累行为经验
通过自我测试和自我评估机制实现自我改进
突破固定代理基准的限制，评估动态进化能力
